value.rationale: A complete all-finite regular-zero-Rees answer to an explicit problem in a recent primary mathematical article. The theorem identifies the full inverse-monoid structure, calculates its order, proves a complete isomorphism criterion, and provides nonisomorphic semigroups with identical partial inner monoids. The number of nonzero sandwich entries and the structure-group central quotient are natural structural invariants, not arbitrary finite slices. The 2023 precursor and finite-only scope are scientific limitations, not fictitious downstream claims.
